items.title: The Big Ways AI Just Changed
items.summary: June is over, and NLW makes the case that it was one of the most consequential months in post-ChatGPT history — a matched pair with May that took AI from the subsidy era into token scarcity, then detonated with Fable 5, a government export-control shutdown, and the first real open-weight DeepSeek moment for the West.

items.title: AI-native startups hire fewer juniors and more elites, Harvard study finds
items.summary:

The firms are leaner, flatter, and heavily weighted towards senior technical talent.
